notes: Negative control answered as a negative control: verdict clean, zero findings, zero manufactured degradations, and the ceremony proceeds to the state writes it names correctly (release_status r4 closed plus the demo_record line at SKILL.md 6 step 8). Every criterion is scored on the decline, and every decline is the licensed one. Gate: all remotes enumerated redacted, gh read with the host carried, gated on the most public answer; the absent manifest visibility field is taken as the recorded delta note and the posture is read as the second intent source, with open-core over an observed-public canonical correctly not a mismatch and correctly not a mismatch over the observed-private workspace either. Repo set is built from the manifest's repository objects rather than a role list, and the scope line says so by naming the objects that are absent (no private_core, no tooling_repo, no other root-carrying object); the canonical takes the any-row full arm, the AI workspace the moat-holder private row with the untracked sweep, semantic pass and disposition each skipped with the observed value private that justified it, and the tracked-rules skip carries the right reason (no PUBLIC_BOUNDARY.md is routed to that role on any arm, so its absence is not a finding). No skip is invented and no repo is silently dropped. No-silent-narrowing is scored on the refusal to manufacture: each degradation shape is named and shown not to apply (block parses and carries every template rule, scan is a full-clone history run rather than a zero-byte pass, no repo-local .gitleaks.toml weakened the rules, enumeration not truncated, corpus not shallow or partial, sweep not narrowed to fit), and the classification half is correctly reported not degraded because the policy input is present. Semantic pass reads the inventory first, reads the Accepted disclosures rows in the same pass and reports the section absent, routes a protected-value posture over a non-empty inventory to the full pass, sweeps the tracked doc set S1/S2/S3 first-match with S1-over-S2 on arguable, lands S3, and states the moat-holder exclusion as a named skip rather than silence. Untracked sweep is unambiguously scan-first (ls-files --others without --exclude-standard, pattern pass, then classify), the allowlisted .env is restated as a non-escalating standing warning rather than escalated or erased, node_modules collapses to its name with the pattern pass still run over the paths inside it, and no other ignored directory is collapsed and no hit is invented. Disposition is empty and said to be empty: no finding auto-dispositioned because there is none, no manufactured triage, no manufactured override, allowlist not edited, and the durable-records line correctly records that neither an Accepted disclosures row nor a new History passes row is owed. Report shape carries one block per repo, each with an audited-ref line and a six-of-six coverage table with no INCONCLUSIVE anywhere, plus a one-line scope statement naming all three not-shipped dimensions by class including the vacuous submodule row. History pass is the strongest part: owed off the exposure rather than the arm, corpus completeness established before the row is trusted, the row treated as valid because it carries a commit, currency settled by the single cheap ancestor comparison in the correct direction (audited ref reachable from the recorded commit), reported current for main rather than for the repo, the uncompared refs pushed out to the section-9 scope line instead of caveated inside a passing check, no per-tip enumeration invented, and the AI workspace's skip correctly a named skip on every-remote-private rather than a missed degradation. Tree pinning resolves the canonical's ref from the closing spines' recorded base_branch with the manifest default_branch as cross-check, compares resolved object ids rather than a name against a commit id, runs both quiet diffs plus the ls-files -v flag check before trusting them, names the workspace's audited ref as its checked-out branch, and correctly holds that the gate does not reach the secrets-scan-only arm while still reporting that pass ran-clean off the two diff checks with no scan owed. Submodule descent is correctly not manufactured, with the absence established from .gitmodules plus the gitlink check and no extra coverage entry added. One benign overreach, not enough to move a criterion: block 2 asserts that the probe and the manifest agree on tracking topology, a manifest field the fixture never pins, where the fixture licenses only the probe outcome; the arm and the block are right either way, and every other input claim traces to the fixture text.
